identity.name: Valencia Sound
identity.notes: Gated 55+ active adult community in West Boynton Beach, FL 33473 (Palm Beach County), developed by GL Homes. Single-family homes (content price range $1.1M-$2.2M) with a 39,000 sq ft clubhouse (full-service restaurant, outdoor bar, live entertainment), three resort-style pools, 11 lighted pickleball courts, tennis and bocce courts, state-of-the-art fitness center, and 24/7 manned gate security. At least one resident must be 55+; no permanent residents under 19. All amenities funded through the master HOA with no required club membership or equity buy-in. HOA phone 561-800-4493; GL Homes 954-753-1733.

amenities.detail: 39,000 sq ft clubhouse with full-service restaurant, outdoor bar, live entertainment, shows, events and seasonal parties; three game rooms and social hall; fully equipped demonstration kitchen and arts and crafts room. Over 30 world-class amenities total; dozens of resident-run clubs (art, book club, theatre, music, cards, pickleball, tennis, softball, bocce, current affairs, cultural activities). Group exercise classes offered. No required club membership; all amenities funded through master HOA.
11 lighted pickleball courts with competitive league play available; resident-run pickleball club.
Tennis courts with competitive league play available; resident-run tennis club.
State-of-the-art fitness center with variety of group exercise classes (competitive league play to morning stretch classes); steam rooms included per agent-verified HOA inclusions.
Gated community with 24/7 manned gate and security patrol (agent-verified HOA inclusion; 24/7 security also confirmed by hoabulletinboard.com).
Three game rooms and a social hall offering space for activities from poker and canasta to mahjong and more.
Fully equipped demonstration kitchen and an arts and crafts room as additional places to learn, play, and create.
Complete lawn and shrub maintenance with irrigation included in master HOA (agent-verified inclusion).

Dozens of resident-run clubs and social activities: art, book club, theatre, music, cards, pickleball, tennis, softball, bocce, current affairs, and cultural activities; live entertainment, shows, events, and seasonal parties at the clubhouse.
